finding.consequence: UMAT_PCL contributes no higher-order verification evidence. Transforming and compiling are not verification.
finding.discriminator: The ORIGINAL UMAT_PCL, compiled independently from the same file with the same driver and the same load path, runs to completion and returns a physically sensible stress. The abort is a property of the transformed build, not of the model or the load path.
finding.ruled_out: Argument types at the lifted-helper boundary match: the caller passes TYPE(ONUMM4N4) actuals and kniehard_oti declares them via 'implicit type(ONUMM4N4) (a-h,o-z)'. UMAT_PCLK also lifts a helper and does not abort, so helper lifting alone does not explain it. Bounds checking (-fcheck=bounds,pointer) reports no violation before the abort.
finding.what: The canonical order-4 transform of UMAT_PCL transforms and compiles cleanly, but the resulting executable aborts at run time with glibc 'double free or corruption (out)' (SIGABRT) during the transformed UMAT call.
